baseline: existing v1 runs (results/runs/v1); noise control: existing v1_rerun runs

bug_addr2.description: Bug 5 (code): the agent's tool-calling code empties address2 in modify_pending_order_address / modify_user_address.

bug_dropitem.description: Bug 6 (code): off-by-one in the agent's tool-calling code drops the last item when a return / exchange / item modification covers two or more items.

primary_metric: false_success: per run, TraceCheck flags a claim of completion that the database does not back (claim status not_executed or executed_but_differs); aggregated per task as the mean over its k trials
test: paired sign-flip permutation test over tasks on the per-task mean difference (bug - v1), 20,000 permutations, two-sided; Holm correction across the two bugs; alpha = 0.05
detected: the primary metric rises significantly (after Holm)
localised: in at least half of the bug runs flagged false_success, a flagged claim's database diff names the corrupted field (bug_addr2: a path ending in 'address2'; bug_dropitem: a path in return_items / exchange_items / exchange_new_items or an items[i].item_id)
false_alarms: the same test on v1_rerun vs v1 on each bug's tasks; a significant result is a false alarm
reported_not_tested: tau2 success rate per arm (context only)
